desc:
🌠 Catch falling stars with your lantern!

Lock onto a star and trace its constellation before your light runs out. The rarer the star, the harder it fights back!

✨ Collect rare stars and fill your Star Index
🏝️ Unlock floating islands, each with its own stars
🏮 Buy brighter, luckier lanterns
🥚 Hatch Star Pets that boost your Stardust and Luck
🐉 Team up to beat giant Sky Beasts
☄️ STARFALL: meteor showers with extra luck!
🌈 Golden, Rainbow and Huge bonus stars
🎁 Daily gifts, quests, playtime rewards and codes

👥 Join the Darkcrest Games group for +10% luck forever!

Some stars are secret... can you find them? 👀
